subject: Post-call recap and POC kickstart blueprint — Lumenate
messages:
From: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
To: alyssa@lumenate.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap and POC blueprint — Lumenate

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the great conversation today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed POC blueprint so we can lock the kickoff and owners. TL;DR: three-week scoped sprint to validate latency and unit-cost improvements on your re-ranking pipeline, plus a small prompt-eval set to track hallucination/regression.

Key pain points you called out
- 95th percentile latency spikes on peak workloads (~400ms) causing downstream timeouts
- High per-request compute cost on re-ranking (~$0.12/request)
- Occasional factual hallucinations in extraction tasks that require manual QA

Primary goals for the POC
- Reduce 95th pctl latency to <= 120ms for 99% of production-like traffic
- Improve tokens/second efficiency to target a 3x cost reduction on inference unit economics
- Establish a reproducible prompt-eval suite that surfaces hallucination regressions (baseline + acceptance thresholds)

Proposed scope (3-week sprint)
Week 0 (prep, access): sample dataset ingestion, access to staging S3, credentials, and a short security questionnaire turnaround
Week 1 (spike & baseline): run a Redwood-verified baseline on a 5k sample, collect latency/cost traces, initial prompt variations
Week 2 (optimization & quantization trial): evaluate batching, prefix caching, and a quantized model variant; run controlled A/Bs
Week 3 (eval & handoff): run prompt-eval slate, generate a short findings deck, and recommend a rollout plan for production

Owners (proposed)
- Lumenate: Alyssa Chen (Product sponsor), Samir Rao (Data/infra lead), security@lumenate.ai (security review)
- Redwood: Jonas Weber (AE/owner), Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer — runtime/ops), Connor O'Brien (Integration engineer)

Access & checklist we need from you
- Staging S3 read access (sample payloads, up to 10GB)
- Example request/response traces from your re-ranker (JSONL)
- IP allowlist for our staging agents OR a short-lived SSH tunnel for initial runs
- Contact for security questionnaire (if your security team prefers a call)

Artifacts attached: poc-scope.xlsx (detailed activities + responsibilities), prompt-eval-template.md (initial prompt categories and scoring rubric).

Next steps
1) Can you confirm owners (Alyssa/Samir + security contact) and whether the staging S3 access is feasible this week?
2) If yes, we’ll provision a short mutual action plan and draft an MPA for signature (attach: mutual-action-plan.docx)
3) Propose kickoff: Monday 2026-10-25 09:00 PT — ok for your team?

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if any of the items need to be adjusted.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Attach: poc-scope.xlsx (stated), prompt-eval-template.md

Following up with concrete owners, the initial prompt-eval categories, and the minimal telemetry we’ll need to validate the acceptance gates. I kept items bite-sized so we can move quickly after access is granted.

Owners (confirmed)

Prompt-eval slate (initial categories)
- Factual extraction (F1, precision/recall) — 250 examples
- Relevance ranking (NDCG@10) — 500 queries
- Hallucination detection (binary judge + severity score) — 200 curated positives/negatives

Telemetry & SLOs
- Latency traces (p50/p95/p99), CPU/GPU utilization during runs, token counts per request
- Cost per 1k inferences (compare baseline vs optimized)
- Regression thresholds: <5% drop on F1, <2% drop on NDCG as acceptance gates for quantized/optimized variants

Minimal access we need immediately
- Staging S3 (read) + path to sample payloads (example: s3://lumenate-staging/poc/samples/)
- Short-lived AWS credentials OR a CIDR block for IP allowlist to our staging agents
- Small shared Drive folder (we’ll place prompt-eval templates and result CSVs)

I’ve placed the initial prompt categories in prompt-eval-template.md (attached) and created a Drive folder link for shared artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-poc-assets

I’ll start drafting the runtime playbook and will ping Samir for the request/response trace format. If you’re good, I’ll also create the kickoff calendar invite for Mon 10/25 09:00 PT.

Thanks —
